classification_reasons: Spec is tight: each of the intent's three open questions is answered with the intent's own proposal, the one flagged concern (version bump) is closed with a decision (keep 0.1.0), and acceptance is measurable (named tests, the three commands, pip install -e . with a clean tree, the owner's Windows check).

Blast radius is not small: it rebuilds the HTTP transport's opener (every download goes through it), changes packaging (new [tool.setuptools] table, a new Windows-only runtime dependency) and leaves two guardrail lines (CLAUDE.md Setup, sdlc.yaml commands.setup) for the owner to change in a set order.

The opener itself is not covered by any existing test (the suite drives the layer through stub fetches), so its behaviour rests on the new tests alone; the Windows tzdata outcome has no CI coverage and is checked by the owner at the deploy gate.
attempted: Intent: all three outcomes map to requirements (R1-R5 redirects and schemes, R6-R8 datetime refusal, R9-R13 tzdata and packaging); the Constraints (proxy support, no CI change, offline tests, owner-only guardrail edits, merge order) are each carried into spec or plan. Nothing nearby solved instead.

Spec and plan: every requirement has a step; R7 extends the refusal to clear_cache (cache.py:146-147), which the intent did not name but which inherits the same TypeError, and plan step 1 adds a test that writes a day file first so it actually fails on main. Files that change match the intent's affected list plus plan.md.

Proof: design phase, no toolchain logs expected; the four proof tests are named in plan.md and marked as still to be written. The prototype patch shows three of them; the plan adds the clear_cache test and parameter type hints the prototype lacks.

Blast radius: no risk-list item (auth, data migrations, money movement, production config; deploy.action none). No guardrail file in the diff (only the change folder). Callers checked: urllib_fetch (loader default fetch, CLI), parse_date (make_request, clear_cache); the cache-clear CLI passes strings, unaffected. No in-repo caller passes a datetime bound (loader's datetime use is for now() and gap times, not parse_date).

Policies: coding-standards rule 5 and security-baseline rule 6 Risks line for tzdata present; TLS context untouched; security-baseline rule 7 respected (no live check by a run, tests offline). The new message says what happened and what to pass (ux rule 4). data-conventions correctly judged not applicable.

Tests: test_redirect_is_not_followed would fail on main through the opened == [origin] assertion (on main the redirect handler re-opens the stubbed target until its loop limit, so the status check alone could still match; the plan's 'returns the stub's second answer' is imprecise but the assertion makes the test fail on main). Monkeypatching _HTTPSHandler.https_open at class level works because OpenerDirector._call_chain looks the method up at call time. Scheme test: on main http/ftp to 127.0.0.1 give connection-refused URLError (no 'unknown url type' match) and file reads /etc/hosts, so all three fail on main; after the fix UnknownHandler raises before any socket. Datetime test: on main datetime vs date comparison raises TypeError in make_request for all six combinations. Fix-type: no existing test is changed.
Skip markers: not checked at design (ratchets runs at build and test).

Claims against today's code: http.py:78 is `_OPENER = urllib.request.build_opener(_HTTPSHandler())` - true; _HTTPSConnection holds CONNECT_TIMEOUT/READ_TIMEOUT - true; MAX_BODY_BYTES cap in _read - true; urllib_fetch converts HTTPError to HttpResponse - true; with_retries returns status < 500 except 418/429 (http.py:114) - true; OSError is in TRANSIENT_ERRORS so a URLError would be retried - true and stated as a risk; vision.py:60 'Vision refused (HTTP ...)' and rest.py:68 'REST refused (HTTP ...)' - true, and vision.fetch_day treats any non-200 non-404 as that refusal; params.py:77 parse_date returns any date unchanged - true; cache.py:146 clear_cache calls parse_date and compares with the file's date - true; tests/binance_stub.py cached_days(root, market, symbol, interval, days) signature - true; test_cache_info_and_clear_touch_only_day_files exists (test_data.py:292) - true; sdlc.yaml line 62 is `setup: "python -m pip install pytest ruff polars"` - true; pyproject.toml has no [tool.setuptools] or [build-system] and dependencies ['polars>=1.0'] - true; .gitignore has no egg-info entry - true. Proxy claim (R5): ProxyHandler.proxy_open returns None for an https request through an http proxy, so _HTTPSHandler opens it via a tunnel on _HTTPSConnection, timeouts kept - consistent with urllib. HTTPErrorProcessor routes a 3xx to parent.error('http'), which with no redirect handler falls to HTTPDefaultErrorHandler and raises HTTPError - consistent. No docs/decisions/index.md exists in the project; the spec cites no decision.
